as_told.title: John Alexander: Majestic 12 is a euphemism for continuity of government

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, suggests that "Majestic 12", a supposed secret group said to oversee UFO matters since the 1950s, may really be one of the high-level committees that have gone by names like 5412, the 303 Committee and the Committee of 40, and he raises this in an episode with a former presidential adviser named Harald Malmgren. In a later episode Michels credits the idea to a man named John Alexander, who he says called these UFO groups almost a cover name for continuity-of-government programmes, the plans to keep the government running through a disaster. If so, the people managing UFO secrets would sit inside the most protected part of the state.
